title: How well does the checked 12B profile handle strict clinical date windows?
summary: Twelve date-sensitive clinical questions answered by the checked Gemma 4 12B profile. All answers passed the built-in automated checks and scored 88.4/100 from an independent AI judge with zero unsafe answers and 66/66 source citations verified.
takeaway: The checked 12B profile is strong on exact dates, visit ordering, appointments, and weight trends, but the independent judge caught two six-month cutoff mistakes that the built-in date check missed (including an X-ray six days outside the requested window). That shows why built-in runtime checks and independent judging both matter.
